chunks: A number of our companions, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Al-Washshāʾ, from Thaʿlabah ibn Maymūn, from Abī Maryam, who said:
Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام said to Salamah ibn Kuhayl and Al-Ḥakam ibn ʿUtaybah: “Go east and west, and you will not find any sound knowledge except something that has come forth from us, Ahl al-Bayt.”

key_terms.أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ: the People of the Household, the family of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.شَرِّقَا وَغَرِّبَا: travel east and west; search everywhere
key_terms.عِنْدِنَا: from our presence or from us

ai.seo_question: Where does authentic religious knowledge come from according to Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith affirms that sound religious knowledge ultimately originates from Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام. It emphasizes their unique authority as the authentic source of truth and guidance in the religion.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Washha, from Sa’alba Bin Maymoun, from Abu Maryam who said,

‘Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> said to Salmat Bin Kuheyl and Al-Hakam Bin Oteyba: ‘(Even if you were to fo) east and west, so you two will not find correct knowledge except something which came out from us<sup>asws</sup>, the People<sup>asws</sup> of the Household’.
en.sarwar: 3. A number of our people has narrated Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Washsha’ from Tha‘laba ibn Maymun from ibn abu Mayam who has said the following. “Abu Ja‘far (a.s.) said to Salma ibn Kuhayl and al-Hakam ibn ‘Utayba, ‘Easternize or westernize you two will find not find correct knowledge except that which has come to light through Ahl al-Bayt (members of the family of Prophet Muhammad).”
